{{Quote|Don't you know he's the one who lost the Battle of Talay?|Moff Broysc falsely accuses Malavai Quinn of having lost the battle|<ref name="Incompetent" />}}
The '''Battle of Talay''' was one of the earliest battles of the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Occurring sometime between [[3681 BBY]] and [[3680 BBY]], the Empire launched its first incursion into [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]], but was met with defeat. [[Broysc]], a [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|military]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] who would later become a [[Moff/Legends|Moff]], commanded the Imperial forces during the conflict at [[Talay/Legends|Talay]] only to watch the battle conclude in a Republic victory.

==Prelude==
The [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] returned from hiding in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] in [[3681 BBY]]. Their return sparked the [[Great Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], which began with the Imperial subjugation of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] through coercion, swift and strategic strikes, and massive invasion forces. In these early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] the primary Imperial war strategy was focused on securing the Outer Rim before moving toward the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Galactic Core]] of the Republic.<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> Despite that plan, at some point prior to [[3680 BBY]],<ref name="EndDate" /> the newly instated [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanding officer]] [[Broysc]] would be among the first to attempt to penetrate the Republic [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="Incompetent" />

==The battle==
In his first command capacity, Broysc led his forces to [[Talay/Legends|Talay]],<ref name="Incompetent" /> a planet in the [[Dufilvian sector/Legends|Dufilvian sector]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> The incursion was unsuccessful, and the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] forces were overcome by Republic defenders.<ref name="Incompetent" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Broysc's earliest command. Before I was born.|Malavai Quinn explains the battle to the Emperor's Wrath|<ref name="Incompetent" />}}
In spite of the loss of his first command engagement, Broysc retained his [[Officer/Legends|officer]] status and ultimately earned the rank of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] by [[3653 BBY]]. However, the promotion did not reflect an improvement in command ability, and Broysc's incompetence was only amplified as he descended into [[dementia]] throughout the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The aging [[Human/Legends|Human's]] addled mind was no longer able to properly reconstruct and recall the events of his earlier life, including the Battle of Talay. While harassing his former subordinate [[Malavai Quinn]], Moff Broysc insisted that Quinn was responsible for the loss at Talay [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] prior. Regardless of the Moff's insistence, Quinn had not yet been [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] when the battle occurred, making it impossible for him to have participated.<ref name="Incompetent" />

[[Standard decade/Legends|Decades]] after their defeat, the Empire would again attempt to conquer Talay, as it remained the site of a major Republic outpost and communication hub, when the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Arkous]] masterminded the [[invasion of Talay]].<ref name="Arkous">{{TORweb|url=info/news/blog/20140731|text=Lana Beniko's Journal: Darth Arkous}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Great Galactic War's Battle of Talay was first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] from [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] that was released in [[2011]]. The battle is referenced in-game by Broysc during a cutscene of a [[Holocomm/Legends|holocommunication]] with the Moff. The conversation is included as part of the [[Empire's Wrath|Sith Warrior's]] quest storyline for companion Malavai Quinn.<ref name="Incompetent" />
